sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your counter-proposal and the suggested 24-month contract term. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We highly value our long-standing partnership and are willing to offer a more favorable price in return for this extended commitment. Therefore, we can revise our offer to €51.30 per unit for a 24-month contract.

For this long relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, our Angebot stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We are proud of our foundry work and look forward to continuing our trusted cooperation with your company.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for your revised proposal; however, the small adjustment still leaves us far from a sustainable price for our foundry. To keep our negotiations moving forward and in appreciation of our long-standing partnership, we can reduce our offer to €50.90 per unit. We must ask for a more substantial step from your side to reach a mutually viable agreement.

For our revised Angebot, we propose a price of €50.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and this agreement will be valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We take great pride in our craft and our enduring business relationship, and we hope this step demonstrates our commitment to finding a common path forward.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised proposal and the step towards our position. It is always a pleasure to work together with partners who value our long-standing relationship and the traditions of our region.

To keep the momentum, we are willing to reduce our price to €50.60 per unit. For this updated Angebot, our terms are a price of €50.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Please understand that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We kindly ask for a more significant move from your side to reach a sustainable agreement for our foundry and our skilled team.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised proposal and the continued movement towards a mutual agreement. It is always a pleasure to work with a partner who values our long-standing relationship as much as we do here in the foundry. 

In recognition of your step, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.40 per unit. Under these updated conditions, our Angebot stands at a price of €50.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We kindly ask for a further step from your side to bridge the remaining gap. We remain confident that our shared history will guide us to a successful conclusion.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
